faq_pricing_cost_estimate: Project costs depend on your specific requirements, feature complexity, design, and target platforms. We offer flexible pricing models including fixed-price and hourly rates. Please contact our team at +91 81283 61116 or email info@optimatrix.in to get a detailed, free quote for your project.
faq_project_timeline: Project timelines vary based on scope: a standard custom website typically takes 2 to 4 weeks, while complex mobile apps or enterprise software can take 6 to 12+ weeks. We define clear milestones and deliverables before kicking off the project.
faq_hire_dedicated_developers: Yes! Opti Matrix offers dedicated developer hiring on full-time, part-time, and hourly engagement models across technologies like PHP, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, iOS, Android, and Flutter. Contact us at info@optimatrix.in to hire developers.
faq_nda_confidentiality: Yes, absolutely. We prioritize client confidentiality and sign a comprehensive Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before discussing project specifics to protect your intellectual property and data.
faq_development_process_methodology: We follow an Agile development process structured into 6 phases: 1) Requirement Gathering & Consultation, 2) UI/UX Design & Prototyping, 3) Core Development, 4) Quality Assurance & Testing, 5) Deployment & Launch, and 6) Post-launch Maintenance & Support.
faq_industries_served: Opti Matrix serves diverse global industries including E-Commerce & Retail, Healthcare, Real Estate, Education & E-Learning, FinTech & Banking, Logistics, Hospitality, and Travel & Tourism.
faq_internship_training: Yes, Opti Matrix provides internship and practical training opportunities for promising students and freshers. You can submit your resume and portfolio via email at info@optimatrix.in or through our website's Careers page.
faq_working_hours_timezones: Our standard office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM (IST). For international clients in the US, UK, and Europe, our teams offer flexible overlapping hours to ensure smooth communication and real-time collaboration.
faq_maintenance_post_launch: Yes, we provide dedicated post-launch support, bug fixing warranty, performance optimization, and customized Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) to ensure your applications remain secure, updated, and fast.
faq_payment_terms_milestones: We follow a transparent, milestone-based payment structure tied to project deliverables (e.g., Initial Advance, Design Approval, Beta Release, and Final Deployment). We accept bank wire transfers, credit/debit cards, and standard international payment gateways.
